title: Tabs that close
description:
Manage open document tabs: open, close, reorder, and choose which tab to show after closing.

```
open a.txt b.txt c.txt, select b.txt
close b.txt -> select c.txt (the one to the right)
close c.txt -> select a.txt (no tab to the right)
open a.txt again -> just selects it
```
hints: After erasing index `i`, the next tab to the right is now at `i`; if `i` is past the end, take `i - 1` (lesson 3.05).
Remember the selected name, not only the index, when moving tabs.
requirements: Tabs are a vector of names and a selected index (or none).
Opening an already open name selects it instead of adding a duplicate.
`move(from, to)` reorders and keeps the same tab selected.
stretch: Ask before closing a tab with unsaved changes (milestone 4 shows modal popups).
